cloud.label: Cloud
cloud.setup: Log in once for the group: create a Desktop OAuth client in a Google Cloud project, save its file with `npx google-services-mcps setup-client`, then run `npx google-services-mcps login cloud`. If no token is stored, the cloud servers fall back to Application Default Credentials.

searchconsole.label: Search Console
searchconsole.setup: Log in once for the group: create a Desktop OAuth client in a Google Cloud project, save its file with `npx google-services-mcps setup-client`, then run `npx google-services-mcps login searchconsole`.

workspace-user.label: Workspace users
workspace-user.setup: Log in once for the group: create a Desktop OAuth client in a Google Cloud project, save its file with `npx google-services-mcps setup-client`, then run `npx google-services-mcps login workspace-user`. Products in this group share the one login.

workspace-admin.label: Workspace admin
workspace-admin.setup: This group uses a service account with domain-wide delegation, not a user login. Create the service account and its JSON key, allow its client ID in the Google Admin console under Domain-wide delegation, then run `npx google-services-mcps setup-admin`.

business.label: Business and advertising
business.setup: Log in once for the group: create a Desktop OAuth client in a Google Cloud project, save its file with `npx google-services-mcps setup-client`, then run `npx google-services-mcps login business`.

developer.label: Developer platforms
developer.setup: Log in once for the group: create a Desktop OAuth client in a Google Cloud project, save its file with `npx google-services-mcps setup-client`, then run `npx google-services-mcps login developer`.

service-account.label: Service account
service-account.setup: This group uses a service account key, not a login. Create the key in the Google Cloud console, then run `npx google-services-mcps setup-service-account` with its path. The suite stores only the path, the account address and the time.

apikey.label: API key
apikey.setup: This group uses an API key, not a login. Save the key with `npx google-services-mcps setup-apikey`; the key is read from the environment or standard input and is never a command-line argument.
